description: We are thrilled to offer a new wheelchair curling competitive opportunity, developed in partnership with Curling Ontario! This exciting new event is open to internationally classified and classifiable athletes. It will run alongside the 2026 Ontario Wheelchair Curling Doubles Provincial Championship event. If you are looking to register for the Ontario Doubles Championship offered by Curling Ontario, please visit their registration page (https://on.curling.io/en/events/pQL7B7jjnVk).
location: 13168 Ilderton Rd, Middlesex Centre, ON N0M 2A0
name: 2026  Wheelchair Curling Mixed Doubles East Event
summary: Wheelchair Curling Mixed Doubles East Event operated by the National Wheelchair Curling Program, in partnership with Curling Ontario
